text: Diagnosis of acute pancreatitis (AP) 0-90 days prior to enrollment date
sub_conditions: Diagnosis made 0-90 days prior to enrollment date

text: Participant fully understands and is able to participate in all aspects of the study, including providing informed consent, completion of case report forms (CRFs), telephone interviews, metabolic testing, and planned longitudinal follow-ups
sub_conditions: Able to complete case report forms (CRFs)
Able to participate in telephone interviews
Able to participate in planned longitudinal follow-ups
needed_info: ability to comply with study procedures

text: Diagnosis of definite chronic pancreatitis (CP) at enrollment based on either of the following criteria met by CT scan (including non-contrast enhanced) or MRI or MRCP: (a) Parenchymal or ductal calcifications on CT scan (after excluding the possibility that calcifications are vascular); (b) Intraductal filling defects suggestive of calcifications on MRI and/or MRCP
sub_conditions: Parenchymal or ductal calcifications on CT scan (excluding vascular calcifications)
Intraductal filling defects suggestive of calcifications on MRI and/or MRCP

text: Potential participants with post-endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography (post-ERCP) AP who are hospitalized for <48 hours.

Prior (i.e., before enrollment) direct endoscopic necrosectomy of the pancreas or percutaneous necrosectomy or drainage of necrotic collection(s). Participants who require this during follow-up will remain in the study
sub_conditions: Prior direct endoscopic necrosectomy of the pancreas
needed_info: procedure history: drainage of necrotic collections

text: Pancreatic tumors, including ductal adenocarcinoma, neuroendocrine tumors, and metastasis
Confirmed or suspected cystic tumor associated with main pancreatic duct dilation, or believed to be the cause of AP (in the site-PI's judgement)
sub_conditions: Confirmed or suspected cystic tumor associated with main pancreatic duct dilation
Cystic tumor believed to be the cause of AP in site-PI's judgement

text: Prior pancreatic surgery, including, but not limited to: distal pancreatectomy, pancreaticoduodenectomy, pancreatic necrosectomy, Frey procedure
Use of disallowed concomitant medications within 30 days prior to enrollment. A comprehensive list of disallowed medications will be included and routinely updated in the study's Manual of Procedures
sub_conditions: Use of disallowed concomitant medications (per Manual of Procedures)
Use within 30 days prior to enrollment

text: Severe systemic illness that in the judgement of the investigative team will confound outcome assessments of DM and immunological outcomes or pose additional risk for harms, including: history of solid organ transplant, AIDS, active treatment for cancer (except non-melanoma skin cancer) within 12 months prior to enrollment, chronic kidney disease with eGFR <30 or on dialysis prior to AP, and cirrhosis (based on imaging or biopsy)
sub_conditions: Active treatment for cancer (except non-melanoma skin cancer) within 12 months prior to enrollment
Chronic kidney disease with eGFR <30 or on dialysis prior to AP
Cirrhosis based on imaging or biopsy

text: Any other medical condition that in the opinion of the site-PI carries a life expectancy of <12 months.
sub_conditions: Other medical condition with life expectancy <12 months in site-PI's opinion

text: Known pregnancy at the time of enrollment. Participants who become pregnant during follow-up will remain in the study, but may have modified study assessments for safety
sub_conditions: Known pregnancy at the time of enrollment

text: Any other condition or factor that would compromise the participant's safety or the scientific integrity of the study
sub_conditions: Any other condition or factor compromising participant safety
Any other condition or factor compromising scientific integrity of the study
